review_scope: Independent read-only audit of all36 full native frames and native-resolution actor crops, with source-composition comparisons. No held-out native output, models or experiment edits used.
severity_note: A visible local source-fidelity/occlusion defect. Broad depth order and overall motion remain coherent; this audit does not claim a general aesthetic failure.
measurement_definition: Restrict to source actor alpha eroded2px and exclude both true foreground alpha and higher actor alpha dilated2px. Missing-pattern proof additionally requires source-vs-decoded RGB MAE>25 and decoded-vs-original-stationary-scene RGB MAE<10. Cream counts require exact original cream RGB(240,216,166). Exact preencode loss counts require preencode RGB equal stationary source RGB and different from expected source composition.

source_pattern_pixels.distance_metric: Chebyshev distance to closest true foreground-alpha pixel

cream_ring_pixels.distance_metric: Chebyshev distance to closest true foreground-alpha pixel

all_exact_preencode_source_loss.distance_metric: Chebyshev distance to closest true foreground-alpha pixel

visual_observation: At frame13 the far actor cream rings and blue fill should remain visible in the left plant stem/leaf gap. The submitted mask instead copies the stationary mural through that gap, removing part of the actor. This is already present in the producer PNG before H.264 encoding.
grader_alignment: The frozen visible-source-pattern failure is supported by actual mask overfill outside the2px boundary allowance. Passing static/depth-crossing checks is consistent: original foreground pixels retain their order while extra background pixels incorrectly cover the moving actor.
